rules.title: Built with Xcode 26+ using the iOS 26 SDK
fix: Install Xcode 26 or later
Archive again and re-export the IPA

rules.title: MinimumOSVersion must be at least 13.0
fix: Raise the deployment target / MinimumOSVersion to iOS 13.0 or later
Archive again and re-export the IPA

rules.title: Required-reason API used without a privacy manifest

sources.title: Apple — Describing use of required reason API

fix: Add a PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy privacy manifest to the bundle
Declare the required-reason API category and reason code used

rules.title: Required-reason API category not declared in privacy manifest

sources.title: Apple — Describing use of required reason API

fix: Add an NSPrivacyAccessedAPITypes entry for the detected category
Choose the correct NSPrivacyAccessedAPITypeReasons code for how the API is used

rules.title: Privacy manifest is malformed or declares an unknown category/reason code

sources.title: Apple — Describing use of required reason API

fix: Fix the malformed PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy plist
Use only documented NSPrivacyAccessedAPIType and NSPrivacyAccessedAPITypeReasons values

rules.title: Listed third-party SDK bundled without its own privacy manifest

timeline.note: Apple requires this for new apps and for app updates that add the SDK; the tool cannot tell which situation applies, so this is always reported as a warning.

fix: Update the SDK to a version that ships its own PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy
Contact the SDK vendor if no version ships a privacy manifest yet

rules.title: Executable is encrypted — API detection is limited
fix: No action needed — this is informational. Re-check with a non-encrypted (locally archived) build for full API detection.

rules.title: targetSdkVersion meets the Play requirement for new apps and updates

timeline.note: An approved extension request can push this deadline to 2026-11-01.

sources.title: Google Play — Target API level requirements

fix: Raise targetSdkVersion to meet the Play requirement for your app's form factor
Test thoroughly against the new target SDK before re-uploading

rules.title: targetSdkVersion should be at least 35 to stay visible to new users

sources.title: Google Play — Target API level requirements

fix: Raise targetSdkVersion to at least 35

rules.title: 64-bit native libraries must be 16 KB page aligned
fix: Upgrade to AGP 8.5.1+ and NDK r28+
Rebuild or update prebuilt .so files and SDKs

rules.title: GNU_RELRO segment must end 16 KB aligned (unless in its own LOAD segment)
fix: Upgrade to AGP 8.5.1+ and NDK r28+
Rebuild or update prebuilt .so files and SDKs

rules.title: Stored (uncompressed) native libraries must be 16 KB zip-aligned (APK only)
fix: Re-run zipalign with -P 16 before signing the APK

rules.title: BundleConfig.pb should request 16 KB alignment when native libs are uncompressed (AAB only)

sources.title: Android — Support 16 KB page sizes (bundletool section)

fix: Upgrade bundletool / AGP so the bundle config requests 16 KB alignment

rules.title: 32-bit native code must ship alongside a matching 64-bit ABI
fix: Build and ship a matching 64-bit (arm64-v8a / x86_64) native library

rules.title: No 64-bit-relevant native code detected
fix: No action needed — this app has no native code, only 32-bit native code, or declares android:pageSizeCompat.
